text:
Maya: Quick, extremely important question — if Redwood could have one office pet (real or mythical) which do you pick? 🐉 🦄 🌿
Sam: Dragon. Obviously.
Dena: Unicorn. Meetings would be shorter via enchantment.
Jorge: Plant. Low maintenance, less insurance, name it 'Throughput'. :cactus:
Liam: We already lose cables to the ficus. No dragons, please. :sweat_smile:
Maya: OK doing a tiny thread poll — reply with one word: Dragon / Unicorn / Plant
Katie: Plant
Sam: Dragon
Dena: Unicorn
Jorge: Plant
Liam: Dragon
Maya: Tally so far — Dragon 2, Plant 2, Unicorn 1. Sudden-death hot takes encouraged. :fire:
Sam: Dragon but only if it fetches coffee and doesn't touch keyboards.
Dena: Unicorn can do PR reviews with rainbow annotations. Imagine the CI logs.
Katie: Plant for naps and passive-aggressive notes about dishes.
Jorge: Naming motion: if plant wins, it's called `Throughput` (yes, I am serious).
reminder-bot: Reminder set — Water office plants tomorrow at 09:00. :droplet:
Maya: Outcome: still a tie. Proposal: plant named Throughput + one imaginary dragon named Latency who sits in a corner and breathes warm air during winter. Compromise? :handshake:
Liam: Compromise accepted. I will bring dragon-shaped cookies next week.
Sam: I'll vote again if cookies are involved. :cookie:
Dena: Also can we nominate someone to actually water Throughput?
Katie: I can on weekdays. Sam you get weekends.
Maya: Perfect. Moss corner + cookie-powered imaginary dragon. Thread closed unless someone has strong objections. :thumbsup:
Sam: No objections. :+1:
Jorge: No objections. Excited for Throughput.
Maya: Cool — tagging facilities to add a little moss shelf and a tiny plaque (j/k but also not).
